title: Koala holding a heart

  <path d='M50 92 C42 84 34 80 34 74 C34 69 39 67 43 69 C47 71 50 74 50 76 C50 74 53 71 57 69 C61 67 66 69 66 74 C66 80 58 84 50 92 Z' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
